This is a WHO error. He attributes policy outcomes (WHAT) to the personal political leanings of staff (WHO) to deflect from his own executive decisions.

Johnson uses a classic pretext-projection loop. He maintains authority by inventing external enemies (civil servants) to explain away his own failed results, avoiding the transparency required for genuine leadership.

The Unavoidable Truth: Migration numbers rose significantly during his premiership.

The Unavoidable Lie: Civil servants acted against his explicit instructions to curb migration.
